research.title: Decimal fractions
research.inspected: Official HTML learning outcomes; focused1–4 on tenths as whole-parts, decimal notation, counting and representations. No full slides/video reading claimed.
research.adopted: Start with a named whole split into ten equal parts; connect quantity, place-value notation and crossingone.
research.rejected: Hundredths/thousandths, rounding, unit conversion and column arithmetic are not silently added to initial tenths scope.
research.usageRestrictions: NCETM default Crown/Open Government Licence with attribution, named-author and third-party qualifications. Conceptual comparison only; no source text/figures/slides/video copied. Copyright page actually retrieved in this production conversation on2026-10-29.

research.title: Comparing Decimals on the Number Line
research.inspected: Official task, commentary, solutions and licence footer. Source diagrams not fetched/copied.
research.adopted: Anchor decimal position to a common unit and scale; digits alone without place do not tell magnitude.
research.rejected: Its hundredths/thousandths comparisons and between-tick approximation exceed current target. Do not use unseen0,07as a core distractor without introducing its unit.
research.usageRestrictions: CC BY-NC-SA4.0 stated. Source used for conceptual boundary comparison; no wording/graphics reused.

planning.concreteToRepresentation: A named paperunit →10equal length parts →one step0,1on fixed0…2line → whole/tenths place chart and Finnish comma. Formal1/10notation supplied optionally; strong M-FRAC-02 never promoted to required.
planning.interaction: Four manual stages connect whole/partition/shading/notation. Independent native integer-step range and +/-tenth controls locate decimal or worded amount on0…2line. Optional readout is support.
planning.help: One whole is fixed,10equal intervals not11tickmarks. Count intervals; label wholebeforecomma andtenthsafter.
planning.advanced: Two ways to describe1,3:13tenths or1whole+3tenths; optional equivalence0,70not mandatoryhundredths skill.
planning.offline: Equal paper strip divisions; metre reference if available, cannot infer real metres from pixels.
